ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (20) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Царство божие» (tsarstvo bozhiye) is 'the kingdom of God' and «осуществление» (osushchestvleniye) 'realization' throughout; in Lamennais's Gospel echo «правды его» (pravdy yego) is 'his justice', as elsewhere in this translation. Kant's quotation of the Slavonic Lord's Prayer («Да приидет царствие твое») is 'Thy kingdom come', while Lamennais's own Russian prayer keeps plain 'your'; Buka's «богослужение» (bogosluzheniye) is 'divine service', to keep its link with «служение ближнему» ('service to one's neighbor').
